SELECT f."Id", f."BookingId", f."FinishedAt", f."GeneratedAt", f."OrderStatus", f."RoomId", s."Id", s."FoodOrderId", s."MenuItemId", s."PriceAtPurchase", s."Quantity", s."Id0", s."Category", s."IsAvailable", s."Name", s."Price"
FROM "FoodOrders" AS f
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT f0."Id", f0."FoodOrderId", f0."MenuItemId", f0."PriceAtPurchase", f0."Quantity", m."Id" AS "Id0", m."Category", m."IsAvailable", m."Name", m."Price"
    FROM "FoodOrderItems" AS f0
    INNER JOIN "MenuItems" AS m ON f0."MenuItemId" = m."Id"
